newsitem.title: USA: Argosy president Norton removed from post.
newsitem.headline: Argosy president Norton removed from post.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said Tuesday it has removed president and chief operating officer from that post.
Also, the company said chief financial officer Joseph Uram has resigned to pursue other interests.
The staff moves come about a week after James Perry assumed the role of chief executive officer, the riverboat casino operator said.
The company and Norton are discussing any future role he might serve, Argosy said.
Argosy is in the midst of a transition from a new jurisdiction casino development company to an operations company, an Argosy spokesman said.
Perry said in a news release that he expects to fill the position of vice president of operations in the near future.
Argosy shares closed up 1/8 at 3-1/2 Tuesday.
